answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 30381 Country: Pakistan Title: I would like to know that since i do sharai parda alhamdulillah i wannt to know that my mother drank milk of one of her related phoppi(wet nurse). so since the dood-shareeq become like real mahram do i have to do parda in front of that wet nurse/phoppis brothers.they are my mothers dood-shareeq mamoo's(uncles).pls reply soon. Question: AOA. i would like to know that since i do sharai parda alhamdulillah i wannt to know that my mother drank milk of one of her related phoppi(wet nurse). so since the dood-shareeq become like real mahram do i have to do parda in front of that wet nurse/phoppis brothers.they are my mothers dood-shareeq mamoo's(uncles).pls reply soon.jazakAllah Answer ID: 30381 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 262/242/B=1432) No, you will not have to observe purdah with the brothers of your phuphi, they became your mahram, as foster uncle is mahram in the same way, the mamu of foster mother is mahram. You need not to observe purdah with them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
